priority_order: Existing low-z CF4/SDSS PV/Union3 input inspection and observer/source contract
Local xAct/Lean/Sage bounded proof and finite-error work
Independent geometric normal and conditional joint tilt classification

execution_boundary.local_implementation_scope: When the user supplies LOCAL_CODEX_PROMPT_KO.md as an instruction, execute its scoped reversible implementation and verification; preserve existing user changes.
execution_boundary.production_or_publication: Follow the user's existing session authorization; do not infer new publication authority merely from a task-plan file and do not request permission again when already granted.

data_availability_policy.large_inputs: Use metadata, bounded samples and the already-owned local data; no catalogue-wide duplicate download.

semantic_acceptance: Source U, normal N, observer O and any radiation R are individually identified; beta always names its pair.
The two axes are material/normal tilt and observer/material motion, with exact Lorentz frame composition.
A finite catalogue does not automatically identify a zero-distance intercept or a spatial tensor derivative.
Schema validation does not certify observation calibration or empirical data availability.
No fresh Bianchi or tilt observational classification is asserted by this task plan.

dag_policy.concrete_claim_gates: TB-N10 may collect unresolved returns; actual U/N exclusion additionally requires an admitted N authority and calibrated joint physical set.

tasks.title: Read theory return and inspect the local execution boundary
inputs: existing local repository AGENTS.md and current branch/head
scope: Record which claims survived the final independent review; candidates alone do not authorize promotion.
Read only the working repository instructions, current head, relevant data registry and targeted existing cosmography/response modules.
Retain dirty/untracked files; do not create worktrees, checkout branches, commit, push, delete data, or download databases.
acceptance: Exact paths and identities of actually read files are recorded.
No absent tool, catalogue, theorem proof or data product is marked available merely because it was mentioned.
failure_cases: Missing final decision: use derived/unreviewed candidates only and state scope.
Missing local catalogue paths: record INPUT_LOCATION_UNRESOLVED, continue theoretical tasks.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: Inventory only; no scientific calculation or repository mutation.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: Input identities and missing fields are explicit.

tasks.title: Inspect actual low-redshift catalogue columns and corrections
inputs: JWST anchors only where they calibrate the selected distance sample
scope: Read catalogue metadata, headers, documented units and bounded representative rows; inspect covariance metadata and correction histories.
Determine which columns provide sky position, observed redshift, distance or distance modulus, source class, uncertainty, selection and source IDs.
Distinguish raw/heliocentric/CMB-corrected redshift, reconstructed peculiar velocity and distances inferred using a fiducial cosmology.
Identify overlap and shared calibrators across samples. Do not treat CF4 velocities corrected using a cosmological flow model as independent raw Doppler observations.
Record the local virialized-region cut, coarse-graining convention and whether a common source flow can extend to the observer.
acceptance: Every column name comes from an inspected source, with units/frame/provenance.
Recoverability of pre-correction redshift and common redshift-distance frame is stated.
Unknown covariance, selection, correction or calibration information remains explicitly unknown.
No redshift-drift measurements are assumed to exist.
failure_cases: Only compressed cosmological summaries available: do not use them as model-independent direction-resolved input.
Irreversible CMB-rest correction or undocumented flow correction: block observer-velocity interpretation for that product.
No finite-distance extrapolation model: mark zero-distance intercept unavailable.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: One catalogue family per worker, read-only metadata plus <=200 representative rows per relevant table.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: Usable quantities and missing contracts are listed; no fitting.

tasks.title: Freeze a common low-redshift observation contract
scope: Instantiate named U component, observer O and unresolved/declared normal N; use distinct U/N, O/U and optional O/R reference pairs.
Define d_A=d_L/(1+z)^2 only under matched source/redshift frames and explicit reciprocity/opacity assumptions.
Keep the endpoint-invariant R=d_L/(1+z) separate from d_A.
Use a free boosted monopole/dipole intercept unless independent calibration supplies its restriction.
Specify finite-distance range, velocity-gradient/acceleration budgets, higher-order cosmographic terms and a genuine remainder bound or an unresolved flag.
Specify masks, selection/bin migration, covariance and shared calibration law before combining catalogue products.
acceptance: Schema validation and semantic frame/pair checks both succeed.
No z/distance forced-through-zero fit is described as the exact zero-distance Hubble derivative.
No raw temperature quantity is inferred from a monopole-subtracted map.
Uncalibrated or missing fields select input_blocked/unresolved output, rather than defaults that imply certainty.
failure_cases: Unrestricted acceleration: disable geodesic eigenframe inversion.
Distance-zero limit inaccessible: retain interval/extrapolation uncertainty; do not claim exact intercept.
Empty joint admissible input set: report input/model incompatibility.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: One low-z contract; no model-choice winner, no data fit.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: All physical and observational assumptions have an explicit status.

tasks.title: Design a bounded observer/source cosmography pilot
inputs: Existing targeted estimator APIs, if present
scope: Specify a joint intercept+slope inference for z(d_A,n) with errors in distance, correlated calibration and source velocity dispersion.
Preserve tensor coefficients and their joint law; do not estimate independent extrema and recombine them as a joint region.
Define calibration under the actual survey mask, selection and higher-distance terms; empirical stability under cuts alone is not a remainder certificate.
Separate reconstruction of O/U from the missing physical normal N. No global tilt estimate is required at this stage.
Define positive, degenerate and misspecified cases before any local execution.
acceptance: The output is a joint coefficient/source-frame set or an explicit failure state.
Tests include U=O, nonzero intercept, vanishing expansion eigenvalue, source acceleration, asymmetric mask, correlated distance calibration and unsupported extrapolation.
No standard chi-square reference law is assumed at nonregular boundaries without justification.
failure_cases: Undefined joint noise law: no calibrated confidence claim.
Nonidentified material flow or eigengap: return a compatible set, not a selected eigenvector.
No finite-error eigenline certificate: coefficients may be reported, physical velocity admission remains conditional.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: Specification of one selected catalogue combination only.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: Pilot can be reviewed without running a full cosmological or Boltzmann solver.

tasks.title: Execute the admitted low-z pilot locally after its inputs are closed
scope: Run only the bounded, admitted source/observer pilot on the selected local sample.
Use existing implementation where suitable; any new implementation requires a separately reviewable local change scope.
Return execution evidence, coefficient confidence sets, calibration diagnostics and unresolved derivative/eigenframe directions.
Do not label the result Bianchi tilt while N remains unresolved.
acceptance: Input IDs, configuration, software versions and logs identify the actual run.
Confidence or practical-equivalence statements only appear if calibration requirements were met.
The full unsupported-input route returns a typed unresolved/input_blocked result rather than numerical best fit interpreted as physics.
failure_cases: Runtime failure: distinguish runtime/transport from mathematical or physical failure.
Selection/covariance mismatch: invalidate calibration, preserve raw evidence.
No scientific run may be marked completed from a plan or mock log.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: One fixed pilot and its predeclared controls; no bulk catalogue reprocessing.
bounded_model_contract.resource_budget: Set by local orchestrator after metadata inspection; do not infer from this proposal.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: Declared pilot and essential controls finished, or a concrete blocker recorded.

tasks.title: Constrained intrinsic-CMB observer/radiation crosscheck contract
inputs: User-owned Planck/Cosmoglobe/BeyondPlanck products selected by explicit availability
scope: Inspect absolute-versus-monopole-subtracted representation, frequency units, beam/pixel transfer, masks, component processing and calibration.
Specify a constrained intrinsic-sky/covariance family; empirical C_l may be nuisance inputs with uncertainty without an external Boltzmann run.
Preserve one common observer endpoint boost across correctly transformed channels, including selection/aberration.
Use the strict inverse-temperature affine criterion only for a positive absolute blackbody sky with known monopole; otherwise record it as analytically inapplicable to the supplied map.
Compare O/R and O/U only with their shared covariance and exact frame composition; call the result matter/radiation streaming until N is identified.
acceptance: No arbitrary intrinsic covariance is silently treated as statistically isotropic.
No transformed temperature inverse is assigned unchanged noise covariance.
No rejection of a strict boosted-isotropic sky is reported as rejection of all non-tilted Bianchi.
failure_cases: Only fluctuation maps available: strict absolute-temperature criterion is not admitted.
Intrinsic family closed under inverse boosts: mark endpoint velocity nonidentified in that family.
Cross-channel/cross-catalogue dependence missing: withhold joint significance.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: One selected temperature product family and one declared intrinsic covariance family.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: A complete crosscheck contract or precise input blocker exists; no full map pipeline run.

tasks.title: Local Wolfram/xAct proof consolidation
scope: Reproduce one convention-consistent derivation per work unit: endpoint intercept, symmetric Hubble lift, curvature-clock tilt identity, or Codazzi perfect-fluid inversion.
Retain c, signature, future direction, sky-direction sign, K sign and flux units.
Keep antisymmetric vorticity outside the symmetric Hubble contraction and preserve the source-acceleration term when geodesicity is absent.
Do not convert test-congruence jet examples into Einstein solutions.
deliverables: Symbolic source and actual kernel transcript for each selected identity
acceptance: Each output links an exact input expression to an executed result.
Reference examples include zero tilt, nonzero tilt, zero/null clock gradient, repeated spatial eigenvalues and zero spatial expansion eigenvalue.
Engine result is described as symbolic verification in scope, not observational validation.
failure_cases: Package/API/runtime failure is separate from identity failure.
Unresolved sign discrepancy blocks only its dependent identity, with both expressions retained.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: Exactly one named identity and at most two limit checks.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: Identity checked or precise discrepancy recorded.

tasks.title: Local Lean/mathlib formalization of bounded mathematical statements
scope: Choose one lemma per task: symmetric null-cone kernel span(g); boost/intercept identity; monotone flux-to-speed map on w>0; or confidence-set image event inclusion.
Separate linear algebra, measure-theoretic measurability and empirical calibration obligations.
Record theorem assumptions, import versions and exact kernel check output.
deliverables: Lean source for the selected lemma
acceptance: No sorry/admit/axiom substitutes are counted as completed proofs.
Formal theorem statement matches physical units and stated finite-dimensional domain, or provides an explicit adapter.
Event inclusion proof is not called proof that the empirical confidence region has coverage.
failure_cases: Missing mathlib definitions: scope down to a precise lemma, not an unverified full claim.
Proof of a single matrix column is not described as a full tensor norm theorem.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: One theorem statement and direct helpers only; no broad library rewrite.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: Selected theorem kernel-checks or a minimal remaining proof obligation is returned.

tasks.title: SageMath/Singular or interval-certified finite-error identified sets
scope: Encode future unit timelike u, B=S-s_t g, geodesic condition and coefficient uncertainty without choosing a raw numerical eigenvector.

Certify spectral separation and timelike-normalization margins over the entire allowed input set where possible; indefinite self-adjoint problems must not inherit Euclidean Davis-Kahan bounds without proof.
Use exact algebra for polynomial structure and a separately justified real-inequality/enclosure method for uncertainty; algebraic elimination alone does not certify real feasibility.
Return outer enclosures, certified exclusions or unresolved branches. Include the continuous timelike-kernel counterexample.
acceptance: All sign, future, normalization and uncertainty inequalities are included.
A missing witness is never called empty; certified emptiness has a checkable certificate.
The image set retains all branches and shared covariance dependence.
failure_cases: Zero gap or uncertainty crosses null/timelike boundary: return a set or unresolved.
Numerical negative discriminant caused by uncertain coefficients: do not clip without preserving input uncertainty.
Pure complex-algebraic solution count is not a real physical classification.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: One coefficient-domain family and one degeneracy family; no all-Bianchi classifier.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: A checkable enclosure/certificate or a sharp unsolved obligation is produced.

tasks.title: Establish a geometric normal independently of matter/radiation
scope: Enumerate compatible N authorities: explicitly assumed homogeneous foliation, timelike curvature-invariant gradient, or a set of admissible homogeneous normals.
For the clock route require observed or declared metric/invariant jet authority, positive timelike-gradient margin and consistency/collinearity of invariant gradients.
Treat curvature clock, total stress eigenframe and individual matter frame as distinct objects.
For Codazzi inversion declare the single-perfect-fluid assumption and w=epsilon+p bounds; no total-flux-to-component-tilt inference in mixtures.
acceptance: A model-assumed N is labeled as assumed, never measured.
No finite light-cone data or spatial homogeneity claim is silently replaced by a complete metric 3-jet.
If N is unresolved, observational results remain O/U and optional U/R; U/N stays unresolved.
failure_cases: Constant/null invariant gradient disables the selected clock route.
No homogeneous foliation authority: do not label the matter flow tilted/non-tilted relative to Bianchi normal.
w touches zero or imperfect/multi-fluid matter: quantitative single-fluid flux inversion not admitted.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: One normal authority route; inspect only sources relevant to its missing inputs.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: Normal identified conditionally, bounded as a set, or explicitly unavailable.

tasks.title: Integrate a joint identified set and return bounded conclusions
inputs: All admitted return artifacts, including explicit unresolved results
scope: Combine only compatible same-state observation models and their actual shared law.
Return surviving action labels, eta_UN bounds, eta_OU bounds, optional eta_UR bounds and their coupled ambiguity.
A positive lower eta_UN gives conditional non-tilt exclusion; a preregistered small upper bound gives practical equivalence; zero in a set is only non-exclusion.
Preserve samplewise MES bodies/denominators and all tensor versions; retain common raw feature-space evidence for label comparison.
Prepare an audit-ready return without repository changes or new downloads.
acceptance: Allowed conclusion types are unresolved, input_blocked, conditional_exclusion, practical_equivalence, conditional_structural_result, or model_incompatible.
No forced three-way winner and no Bianchi label inferred from a CMB velocity alone.
Claims name the material component, N authority, observer pair, domain, uncertainty calibration and assumptions.
No claim of global tilt if normal identification remains open.
failure_cases: Incompatible domains/conventions/corrections: do not merge; return the mismatch.
Missing cross-law covariance: withhold combined significance.
Empty global model set: report model incompatibility, not an infinite speed bound.

bounded_model_contract.one_worker_scope: Integrate supplied bounded returns only, without restarting broad research or a full solver.
bounded_model_contract.stop_condition: Every claim has a scope/evidence state and every unresolved dependency a minimal next input.

cleanup_policy.original_data: Preserve all original catalogues, masks, covariance files and previous evidence.
cleanup_policy.temporary_products: Remove only identified reproducible temporary files created by a separately executed local task after its evidence manifest is recorded; no deletion is requested by this plan.
cleanup_policy.repository: Preserve dirty/untracked and previous research artifacts.
